paragraphs: Experience modern dental care designed for the Holly Ridge community.
Our experienced team of dental professionals is committed to providing exceptional care with the highest standards of clinical excellence and patient comfort.
Comprehensive dental care for every member of your family. From routine cleanings to advanced treatments, we provide exceptional care with the latest technology and techniques.
Our experienced team of dental professionals is committed to providing exceptional care with the highest standards of clinical excellence and patient comfort.

Located along US-17 (Ocean Highway) in Onslow County, our Holly Ridge office is convenient for patients traveling between Jacksonville and Wilmington. We’re just minutes from Topsail Island and close to growing neighborhoods like Folkstone and Mimosa Bay.

At Riccobene Holly Ridge, we bring compassionate, cutting-edge dental care to a growing coastal community. Families from Sneads Ferry, Surf City, and beyond trust us to deliver comfortable, family-focused dentistry year-round.
We believe in the Riccobene Way - a commitment to deliver better dentistry, better experiences and better results with a comprehensive and compassionate approach.
When you help a lot of people you get to some large numbers that we’re proud of - each satisfied patient is another happy smile.
Can't make it to our Holly Ridge office? We have other convenient locations in the area to serve you with the same exceptional dental care.
Quality dental care should be accessible to everyone. We offer flexible payment options, accept most insurance plans, and provide affordable membership plans for uninsured patients.
Save money on dental care with our affordable annual membership plans. No insurance? No problem! Get the care you need at a price you can afford.

We strive to provide same day or next day care for those with dental emergencies, either at our Holly Ridge location or another convenient Riccobene location to prioritize solving urgent issues. Whether you have a broken or cracked tooth, a damaged crown, or undiagnosed severe tooth pain, we can help diagnose and treat urgent oral problems at our Holly Ridge location. Give us a call today to schedule an emergency appointment.
Yes - we can help your whole family with their oral health! Parents, bring your kids. (Kids, definitely bring your parents!). We want your whole family smiling widely and brightly.

Yes - professional teeth whitening is one of the most common cosmetic dental procedures we see at our Holly Ridge location, and we offer a variety of other options including veneers that help you get your smile looking just the way you want.
Yes - we offer expert care diagnosing and managing your dental implant procedure. Some implants can be performed in-office, while other procedures may be performed at an outpatient surgery facility.
Booking an appointment is as simple as making a phone call or scheduling online. You can reach us at (910) 329-8191 and we’ll get you on the schedule as soon as possible!

We accept and participate with a large majority of insurance plans. Prior to any treatment, our team will perform a complimentary benefits evaluation to let you know what your insurance covers. We also offer flexible payment options and an affordable dental membership plan for patients without insurance.
Take the first step towards optimal oral health. Contact our Holly Ridge office to schedule your appointment or ask any questions about our dental services.
Fill out the form below and we'll get back to you within 24 hours.

Call our Holly Ridge Office at 910-329-8191, or use the form below to request an appointment.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
What emergency dental services are available in Holly Ridge, NC?

We strive to provide same day or next day care for those with dental emergencies, either at our Holly Ridge location or another convenient Riccobene location to prioritize solving urgent issues. Whether you have a broken or cracked tooth, a damaged crown, or undiagnosed severe tooth pain, we can help diagnose and treat urgent oral problems at our Holly Ridge location. Give us a call today to schedule an emergency appointment.

Do you offer family and pediatric dentistry in Holly Ridge?

Yes - we can help your whole family with their oral health! Parents, bring your kids. (Kids, definitely bring your parents!). We want your whole family smiling widely and brightly.

Can I get cosmetic dental services like teeth whitening or veneers in Holly Ridge?

Yes - professional teeth whitening is one of the most common cosmetic dental procedures we see at our Holly Ridge location, and we offer a variety of other options including veneers that help you get your smile looking just the way you want.

Does the Holly Ridge office provide dental implants?

Yes - we offer expert care diagnosing and managing your dental implant procedure. Some implants can be performed in-office, while other procedures may be performed at an outpatient surgery facility.

How can I schedule an appointment with a Holly Ridge dentist?

Booking an appointment is as simple as making a phone call or scheduling online. You can reach us at (910) 329-8191 and we’ll get you on the schedule as soon as possible!

What payment options and insurance plans does the Holly Ridge office accept?

We accept and participate with a large majority of insurance plans. Prior to any treatment, our team will perform a complimentary benefits evaluation to let you know what your insurance covers. We also offer flexible payment options and an affordable dental membership plan for patients without insurance.
